description: The OpenCode hooks the Jentrix plugin subscribes to (it runs in-process — nothing here is a command OpenCode executes) and the ledger lines it appends for the Jentrix session host. Credentials and transcript bytes never leave the machine through this plugin; the ledger is 0600 under the operator's home.

env.OPENCODE_SESSION_ID: this session's id, injected into every bash tool command
